generated_prompts.CD8_T: CD8+ cytotoxic T lymphocytes from human lung adenocarcinoma tumor microenvironment. Tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells expressing cytotoxic effector molecules and exhaustion markers.
generated_prompts.Macrophage: Tumor-associated macrophages from human lung adenocarcinoma. Myeloid macrophage populations in the cancer microenvironment with mixed M1/M2 polarization states.
generated_prompts.Epithelial_tumor: Malignant epithelial cells from human lung adenocarcinoma. Cancer cells of epithelial origin expressing proliferative and lung adenocarcinoma-specific markers.
generated_prompts.Fibroblast: Cancer-associated fibroblasts from human lung adenocarcinoma stroma. Stromal fibroblast populations supporting the tumor microenvironment.
